lines.rom: arati karata yasoda pramudita phuli anga na mata bala bala kahi dularavata ananda magana bhai pulakata
subarana thara ratna dipavali citrita ghrta bhini bata kala sindura duba dadhi acchata tilaka karata bahu bhamta
anna caturvidha bibidha bhoga dundubhi bajata bahu jata nacata gopa kumkuma chirakata deta akhila nagadata
barasata kusuma nikara sura nara muni vrajajuvati musakata krsnadasa prabhu giradhara ko mukha nirakha lajata sasi kamta
